description: This file defines a REST API resource for the Mix Taxonomy in the Apache Fineract project. It exposes an endpoint to retrieve all MixTaxonomyData objects, utilizing JAX-RS annotations for routing and Swagger annotations for documentation.

classes.name: MixTaxonomyApiResource
classes.description: REST controller handling Mix Taxonomy API endpoints, providing access to retrieve all taxonomy data.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to fetch all MixTaxonomyData entries. It authenticates the user and calls the service layer to retrieve data.
